comment: Overrides for swiftpm-notices.py when server/Dockerfile writes /usr/share/doc/monkeyspaw-server/Third-Party-Notices.txt for monkeyspaw-server, built with --static-swift-stdlib from server/Package.resolved. Paths are relative to this file; $SWIFT_LICENSE is the toolchain's share/swift/LICENSE.txt, located by the build. The deb's notices use packaging/licenses/third-party-notices.json.
preamble: Monkey's Paw's own code is released under the Unlicense (see LICENSE next to
this file). The components below are statically linked into monkeyspaw-server
and keep their own licenses. System packages from the image keep their

yams.reason: Yams vendors libyaml's C sources (Sources/CYaml, libyaml commit acd6f6f per Yams' 4.0.5 changelog) without libyaml's license file; this is libyaml's License at that commit.

components.name: BoringSSL (in swift-crypto)
components.reason: swift-crypto vendors BoringSSL as Sources/CCryptoBoringSSL without BoringSSL's LICENSE; this is BoringSSL's LICENSE at the revision its hash.txt names (SHA-256 827c8d8fc207c2392794eef9e00fe246f9f61fdcc132556c275be3dd8c3cd97f). The Go and Chromium sections cover test and build code that is not compiled in.

components.name: BoringSSL (in swift-nio-ssl)
components.reason: swift-nio-ssl vendors BoringSSL as Sources/CNIOBoringSSL without BoringSSL's LICENSE, and its files point to the OpenSSL and ISC licenses; this is BoringSSL's LICENSE at the revision its hash.txt names (SHA-256 756a61a8300d105ae68e7f2993e27d41a765c946f3400422e2403b01e7ded527): the OpenSSL and SSLeay licenses, ISC, and MIT for third_party/fiat.

components.name: ICU
components.reason: --static-swift-stdlib links Foundation's lib_FoundationICU (ICU 76.1 for Swift 6.4, data icudt76l); see packaging/licenses/third-party-notices.json for the text's provenance. static-runtime-notices.py fails when the binary's ICU data version differs.

components.name: Swift standard library, Foundation and libdispatch
components.reason: Statically linked by --static-swift-stdlib. The Runtime Library Exception waives attribution; listed for completeness with the toolchain's own LICENSE.txt.

components.name: Unicode Character Database tables
components.reason: Core's SearchUnicodeData.swift and SyncPathCaseFold.swift, linked into the server, are generated from the UCD.
